facts.statement: Zupaysaurus was discovered in May 1997 by Santiago Reuil and formally described by Andrea Arcucci and Rodolfo Coria in 2003.
facts.quote: Discovered in May 1997 by Santiago Reuil ("Vultur"), part of the crew of Guillermo Rougier, it was later described by Arcucci and Coria and published in 2003.

facts.statement: The name Zupaysaurus translates to "devil lizard," combining the Quechua word for devil and the Greek word for lizard.
facts.quote: The name Zupaysaurus is composed of the Quechua word supay meaning "devil" and the Greek word (σαυρος) meaning "lizard"; thus "devil lizard".

facts.statement: The species name Z. rougieri honors Guillermo Rougier, who led the expedition that found the holotype specimen PULR-076.
facts.quote: The type species was named Z. rougieri in the honor of Guillermo Rougier, the scientist who led the expedition which discovered and collected the holotype (original specimen) PULR-076.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus was an early theropod dinosaur that lived during the Norian stage of the Late Triassic in what is now Argentina.
facts.quote: Zupaysaurus (; "ZOO-pay-SAWR-us") is an extinct genus of early theropod dinosaur which lived during the Norian stage of the Late Triassic in what is now Argentina.

facts.statement: The original Zupaysaurus specimen dates to at least 213 million years ago from the late Norian stage of the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: The original specimen is from the upper part of the Los Colorados Formation, at least 213 million years old (from the late Norian stage of the Late Triassic).

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus lived between 226 and 206 million years ago, spanning from the Norian to the Rhaetian stages of the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: que vivió a finales del período Triásico entre 226 y 206 millones de años, desde el Noriense al Rhaetiense

facts.statement: Precise dating estimates place the Los Colorados Formation, and thus Zupaysaurus, between 227 and 213 million years ago.
facts.quote: More precise dating estimates constrain the Los Colorados Formation between 227 and 213 million years ago, with Zupaysaurus and its contemporary fauna in the upper part of the formation.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus lived in an ancient floodplain environment alongside early sauropodomorph dinosaurs such as Riojasaurus, Coloradisaurus, and Lessemsaurus.
facts.quote: The Los Colorados Formation was interpreted as an ancient floodplain and it was home to several types of early sauropodomorph dinosaurs (including Riojasaurus, Coloradisaurus, and Lessemsaurus), all of which shared the same paleoenvironment with Zupaysaurus.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus is considered a bipedal predator that could reach up to 4 meters in length, though no complete skeleton has been found.
facts.quote: Although a full skeleton has not yet been discovered, Zupaysaurus can be considered a bipedal predator, up to 4 m long.

facts.statement: A 2016 study estimated Zupaysaurus to be 4.2 meters long and weigh 70 kilograms.
facts.quote: In 2016 it was given a much smaller size of 4.2 meters (14 ft) and 70 kg (154 lbs).

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus walked exclusively on its hind legs, freeing its forelimbs to grasp prey.
facts.quote: Like all theropods, Zupaysaurus walked only on its hindlegs, leaving its forelimbs free to grasp its prey.

facts.statement: Later analysis identified the supposed skull crests of Zupaysaurus as a displaced nasal bone rather than true crests.
facts.quote: A skull redescription by Ezcurra (2007) identified the "crests" as a displaced right nasal bone, flipped over so its underside is visible in right lateral view.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus possessed a rough lacrimal ridge projecting from the upper edge of its skull.
facts.quote: Other cranial ornamentation included a rough lacrimal ridge projecting outwards from the upper edge of the skull.

facts.statement: Yates (2006) classified Zupaysaurus within the monophyletic family Dilophosauridae alongside Dilophosaurus and Dracovenator.
facts.quote: Yates (2006) found Zupaysaurus to form a group with Dilophosaurus and Dracovenator, placing it in a monophyletic Dilophosauridae.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus is classified as a dilophosaurid theropod dinosaur.
facts.quote: de dinosaurio terópodo dilofosáurido

facts.statement: The well-preserved braincase of the holotype allowed researchers to reconstruct Zupaysaurus's brain anatomy using a digital endocast.
facts.quote: The skull's degree of preservation is good enough that it preserves a braincase, allowing for a reconstruction of Zupaysaurus's brain anatomy via a digital endocast.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Zupaysaurus possessed tall narrow crests or merely low ridges along its snout, with later studies suggesting the crests were misplaced bones.
facts.quote: Originally described as having a pair of tall narrow crests on its skull, a later study argued that the "crests" are misplaced bones, and that Zupaysaurus probably had low ridges along the edge of its snout instead.

facts.statement: There is debate regarding Zupaysaurus's classification, as it displays features of both tetanuran theropods and more basal theropods.
facts.quote: However, several features typical of more basal theropods were also noted by the original authors.

facts.statement: The adult skull of Zupaysaurus reached a length of 45 centimeters.
facts.quote: El cráneo del adulto llegó a los 45 cm de largo.

facts.statement: Like other members of its class, Zupaysaurus was bipedal.
facts.quote: Como otros de su clase, el Zupaysaurus era bípedo.

facts.statement: A small gap between the premaxillary and maxillary teeth in the upper jaw, and the fusion of the astragalus and calcaneum in the ankle, place Zupaysaurus among primitive theropods.
facts.quote: Un pequeño espacio separando los dientes premaxilares de los maxilares en el maxilar superior, y la fusión del astrágalo y calcáneo en el tobillo, lo ubican junto a los terópodos primitivos.

facts.statement: Like coelophysoids, Zupaysaurus had a twist in the snout between the premaxillary and maxillary bones of the upper jaw.
facts.quote: Como los celofisoides, Zupaysaurus tiene una torcedura en el hocico, entre los huesos premaxilares y maxilares de la mandíbula superior.

facts.statement: The length of recovered neck bones suggests that the genus Zupaysaurus had a fairly long neck.
facts.quote: La longitud de los huesos del cuello recuperados sugiere que este género tiene un cuello bastante largo.

facts.statement: Additional cranial ornamentation included a rough lacrimal crest projecting laterally on the top of the skull.
facts.quote: Otra ornamentación craneal incluía una rugosa cresta lagrimal que se proyectaba lateralmente en la parte superior del cráneo.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus was discovered in May 1997 by Santiago Reuil, part of Guillermo Rougier's team, and was described by Arcucci and Coria in 2003.
facts.quote: Descubierto en mayo de 1997 por Santiago Reuil, parte del equipo de Guillermo Rougier, luego fue descrito por Arcucci y Coria y publicado en 2003.

facts.statement: The type species was named Z. rougieri in honor of Guillermo Rougier, the scientist who led the expedition that discovered and collected the holotype PULR-076.
facts.quote: La especie tipo fue nombrada Z. rougieri en honor a Guillermo Rougier, el científico que lideró la expedición que descubrió y recolectó el holotipo, PULR-076.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus was first described and named in the scientific journal Ameghiniana by Argentine paleontologists Andrea Arcucci and Rodolfo Coria in 2003.
facts.quote: Zupaysaurus fue descrito y nombrado por primera vez en la revista científica Ameghiniana por los paleontólogos argentinos Andrea Arcucci y Rodolfo Coria en 2003.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen PULR-076 consists of an almost complete well-preserved skull, the right shoulder girdle, the lower part of the right leg and ankle, and twelve vertebrae of the neck, back, and hips.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotipo fue designado PULR-076, que consta de un cráneo casi completo que estaba muy bien conservado, la cintura escapular derecha, la parte inferior de la pierna y el tobillo derechos y doce vértebras del cuello, la espalda y las caderas.

facts.statement: The formation where Zupaysaurus was found has been dated by magnetostratigraphy to the Norian stage of the Late Triassic, approximately 228 to 208 million years ago.
facts.quote: Esta formación ha sido mostrada por magnetoestratigrafía hasta la etapa Noriense del período Triásico Tardío , hace aproximadamente 228 a 208 millones de años.

facts.statement: The fauna of the Los Colorados Formation is recognized as one of the earliest known dinosaur-dominated assemblages, where dinosaurs made up 43% of the known tetrapod species.
facts.quote: Se reconoce como uno de los primeros conjuntos de fauna conocidos dominados por dinosaurios, que eran el 43% del número de especies de tetrápodos conocidas actualmente.

facts.statement: Zupaysaurus was classified as the oldest known tetanuran theropod due to various characteristics of its skull, dentition, and hind limbs.
facts.quote: Zupaysaurus fue clasificado como el terópodo tetanurano más antiguo conocido debido a varias características de su cráneo, dentición y extremidades posteriores.

facts.statement: In 2006, Yates found that Zupaysaurus formed a group with Dilophosaurus and Dracovenator, placing it in the monophyletic Dilophosauridae.
facts.quote: Yates en 2006 encontró que Zupaysaurus formaba un grupo con Dilophosaurus y Dracovenator, ubicándolo en un monofilético Dilophosauridae.

facts.statement: However, more recent analyses of the skull have cast doubt on the presence of the crests in Zupaysaurus.
facts.quote: Sin embargo, análisis más recientes del cráneo han arrojado dudas sobre la presencia de estas crestas en Zupaysaurus.

facts.statement: An unpublished summary presented at a recent conference indicated that the structures initially identified as crests were actually lacrimal bones displaced upward during the fossilization process.
facts.quote: Un resumen inédito presentado en una conferencia reciente indicó que las estructuras inicialmente identificadas como crestas eran en realidad los huesos lagrimales desplazados hacia arriba durante el proceso de fosilización.

facts.statement: But later studies found that Zupaysaurus was a sister taxon to a clade containing dilophosaurids, ceratosaurians, and tetanurans.
facts.quote: Pero estudios posteriores encontraron que Zupaysaurus era un taxón hermano de un clado que contenía dilofosáuridos, ceratosaurianos y tetanuros.

facts.statement: The time range for Zupaysaurus is the Norian stage, from 227.3 to 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (227.3 to 205.7 million years ago)
